# T-1: Define hook failure policy contract

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add a validated required/advisory policy to flow command hook registration and persisted snapshots. Define typed hook execution outcomes that distinguish policy-governed business failures from integrity failures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 registration and snapshot validation rejects missing and unknown policy values.
- R2 runner returns a typed outcome consumed without warning-code severity inference.
- R5 integrity failures remain hard failures for both policies.

## Implementation Notes
Extend the existing hook class and snapshot validation path in plugin-registry. Use dedicated classes for policy and execution outcomes, with invariant checks in constructors.

## Test Strategy
Extend plugin-registry tests for policy validation, snapshot validation, and integrity failure categories.
